text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah? Whaddya want, punk? Stop glaring at 
me!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute. You don't mean, you 
bast—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You didn't come here just to whine and 
complain about the calories and fat in 
this, did ya?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I know that already, you don't have to 
tell me twice!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm—chugging all of this! And 
then, I'm gonna run like crazy! Until 
there ain't a single crumb of calories 
left!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Fine, I get it, just leave me alone!
